Coroner Finds Missed Opportunities in Melbourne Girl's Death

A Victorian coroner has found that doctors at Monash Medical Centre missed opportunities to save the life of 8-year-old Amrita Lanka in 2022. The coroner stated that a Monash doctor contributed to the child's death.
